topic: Someone receives flowers with no card attached
text: I just got a beautiful bouquet of flowers this morning, delivered right to my door. No note, no card, nothing to indicate who might have sent them. I’ve been standing here, surrounded by their sweet fragrance, trying to piece together the puzzle of who could have thought of me. They’re absolutely stunning – a mix of roses and lilies, and the colors are just so vivid. I wonder if it’s someone I know well, or maybe just a friendly gesture from a colleague. I should probably check my calendar to see if I missed something significant. For now, I’ve found the perfect spot for them on the dining table, where I can enjoy them all day.
